== re: video ==
First and foremost I would encourage you to join our discord(linked on the front page of the wiki) for more effective communication. You can then post there or DM me(ctvrty, nickname blorbo) the link to the blog post you are talking about. However, something that is a telltale sign of being fake is a lack of a PGP signature from 3301. I am unable to locate the post you are referring to at this time to verify myself.[[User:Ctvrty|ctvrty]] ([[User talk:Ctvrty|talk]]) 21:55, 31 July 2023 (UTC)
== re: re: video ==
The link you posted on Tweqx's talk page is a known fake puzzle, unfortunately. It has plagued our community for years. It seems they lied about having "reversed" the hash in order to promote it. They didn't even bother to explain how they did it(because they can't, because they didn't.) No PGP == No Cicada. [[User:Ctvrty|ctvrty]] ([[User talk:Ctvrty|talk]]) 22:01, 31 July 2023 (UTC)
